final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS c FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), s AS (SELECT t, c, c * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM j) AS sh FROM j), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - (SELECT av FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE sh > (SELECT av FROM a)
